pass_gate: Candidate must be six-body safe and collision-free in all 8 fresh episodes, achieve clean dynamic source-to-foot transfer in at least 6/8, and qualified own second foot after >=0.20s, outgoing >=2m/s with no nonfoot between in at least 4/8. It must exceed frozen Parent local B6 count by >=3. A local B6 Fresh pass does not imply full goal or video authorization.
selection_lock: Weights fixed before any Fresh simulation; do not tune on these scenes. If rejected, retire this exam and open new training scenes, never re-label its failures as training success.
